hotels.title: Tamborine Mountain Boutique Retreat w. Spa, Wellness Studio & Panoramic Mountain Views
hotels.description: Perched on the escarpment of Tamborine Mountain, this boutique hotel’s minimalist European-inspired design offers a cocoon of calm in Queensland’s hinterland. Enjoy your morning coffee on a private balcony or terrace with sweeping mountain views, then unwind in the heated mineral pool or heated spa with a refreshing drink in hand. Nestled in subtropical rainforest yet just 30 minutes from the Gold Coast, the area is home to Witches Falls Winery, known for producing wines of exceptional quality and character, gourmet restaurants and art galleries. Between excursions, indulge in Tamborine’s curated massages and facials or relax poolside with light bites on a sun-soaked lounger.
